objective:
Perform a comprehensive security assessment of localhost. 
    Identify open ports, discover hidden directories, and test for common web vulnerabilities 
    including SQL injection. Ensure all tests are non-intrusive and respect the target scope.

tasks.description: Perform a network scan to identify open ports and services running on devices within the local subnet.
Conduct a network scan to discover open ports and services on devices within the larger subnet.
Use Gobuster to discover hidden directories and files on the target web application.
Utilize FFUF to perform a fuzzing attack to find additional hidden endpoints and resources on the web application.
Test for SQL injection vulnerabilities on the target web application using SQLMap.
